choose.title: Choose a workspace
choose.subtitle: You belong to several. Pick the one to work in; you can switch at any time from the top of the menu.

admin.subtitle: Separate areas of work. Records like products belong to one workspace and only its members see them.
admin.newText: Add members after creating it; only members can work in it.

fields.name: Name
fields.keyHint: Lowercase letters, digits, - and _; it cannot be changed later
fields.keyInvalid: Start with a letter; use 2 to 64 lowercase letters, digits, - or _
fields.keyFixed: Set when the workspace was created

suspend.title: Suspend {name}?
suspend.text: Its members can no longer work in it, and it disappears from their workspace menu. Its records are kept; reactivate it to bring them back.

tenancy.suspendedHint: Suspended: its members cannot work in it until it is reactivated.
